sourceMappings.reason: Leaf extraction avoids a dependency on composite navigation. Remaining composite implementation belongs to bsolid-composite.

adaptations: Native MouseEvent/PointerEvent/FocusEvent replace React synthetic event types. isMouseWithinBounds retains its explicit HTMLElement currentTarget requirement.
Solid JSX.CSSProperties uses kebab-case CSS keys and explicit px for dimensions; inertValue passes native boolean/undefined through.

platform.os/engine/env/screenReader flag properties retain caller syntax but read lazily instead of resolving navigator/CSS during import. Direct internal category modules export getter objects rather than eager boolean bindings; no pinned callers use direct category imports.
ownerDocument additionally accepts Node, Document and undefined; fallback document is evaluated only on invocation. ownerWindow and realm predicates use installed @floating-ui/utils/dom.
contains preserves native containment and also traverses assigned slots as required by the ticket; closest and getTarget retain source traversal and post-dispatch fallback.
fastObjectShallowCompare uses realm-independent object/function tests rather than instanceof Object, including null-prototype records; enumerable-key and Object.is semantics retained.

element.ts consumes the bootstrap TriggerLookup type and shared TRIGGER_DISABLED_ATTRIBUTE='data-trigger-disabled', with no popup/tooltip runtime dependency. isEventTargetWithin retains the source's dispatch-time composedPath behavior, distinct from getTarget's post-dispatch fallback.

enqueueFocus retains one latest-focus queue, cancels via the window that scheduled it, and makes null-element cancellation safe without global RAF. shouldFocus is checked at execution; stale cleanup cannot cancel a replacement.

markOthers retains source outside-tree selection, script/live-region handling, and independent aria/marker counts. It additionally restores exact original values (including aria-hidden=false and preexisting marker strings), is idempotent on cleanup, and corrects nested shadow targets to their outer host.

disableFocusInside/enableFocusInside retain source marker API with raw weak-map locks for overlapping containers. Exact tabindex/data-tabindex values and SVG/moved nodes restore after final release. Existing externally saved data-tabindex markup remains supported.
No React dependency, old Solid port, reactive store, floating hook, observer proxy, shared manifest, export barrel or reference edit introduced.
